newsitem.title: UK: UK'S GLYNWED BUYS U.S. PLASTIC PIPE CO IPT.
newsitem.headline: UK'S GLYNWED BUYS U.S. PLASTIC PIPE CO IPT.

text.p: British industrial group Glynwed International Plc said on Thursday it bought U.S. company Industrial Plastics Technology Inc (IPT) for a maximum of $23.67 million.
Glynwed said the purchase was a significant step in its acquisition strategy for its pipe systems division to achieve nationwide distribution coverage in the U.S.
IPT distributes industrial pipes, fittings and ancillary components throughout the eastern states of the U.S.
The Financial Times said on Wednesday that Glynwed will look for acquistions worth up to 100 million stg as part of a strategy to reshape the group.
